# pvecli storage content

Manage storage content.

## list

List storage content.

```text
pvecli storage content list [NODE] [STORAGE] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |
| `STORAGE` | Storage ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-t`, `--type VALUE` | Filter by content type. |

## add

Upload content to storage (ISO images, container templates, or import content).

```text
pvecli storage content add [NODE] [STORAGE] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |
| `STORAGE` | Storage ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-s`, `--source-file VALUE` | Path to file to upload. |
| `-t`, `--type VALUE` | Content type: iso, vztmpl, or import. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |

## download

Download content from a URL directly to Proxmox storage.

```text
pvecli storage content download [NODE] [STORAGE] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |
| `STORAGE` | Storage ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-u`, `--url VALUE` | URL to download from. |
| `-f`, `--filename VALUE` | Target filename (default: extracted from URL). |
| `-t`, `--type VALUE` | Content type: iso, vztmpl or import. |
| `-c`, `--checksum VALUE` | Expected checksum. |
| `-ca`, `--checksum-algorithm VALUE` | Checksum algorithm (md5, sha1, sha256, sha512). |
| `-b`, `--background` | Start download and return immediately. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |

## remove

Delete content from storage.

```text
pvecli storage content remove [NODE] [STORAGE] [VOLUME] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name. |
| `STORAGE` | Storage ID. |
| `VOLUME` | Volume ID to delete. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
